title: Cobblemon:Monuments of Hoen
description: Adds 3 new structures to your Cobblemon world: Sky Pillar for obtaining Rayquaza, The Marine Temple for Obtaining Kyogre and the Magma Shrine for Groudon
body:
⚠️Warning! I highly reccomend building a box or large platform around sky pillar so that Rayquaza can't fly away and despawn because it's AI tends to do that


Monuments of Hoen is a Cobblemon addon that adds structures to spawn in legendary Pokemon.

To do this the mod utilizes items from Mega Showdown as summoning items: [Mega Showdown](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-mega-showdown)
Right now it adds the following Pokemon in the following structures:

Rayquaza summoned at Sky Pillar (hoenmonuments:sky_pillar) found in desert biomes, by right clicking one of the two Jade Pedestals with the new Jade orb item added by the mod crafted with 4 (Mega Showdown) Dragon Tera Shards and a Nether Star:
![recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ab5e341cea5bc54b3143c73e2478715005c87633.png)
![Sky Pillar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/750b61c6cd16bb4e64863e113e5c790cceddc399_0.webp)

Kyogre can be spawned by rightclicking on the Marine Pedestal in the Marine Temple structure with a Blue Orb item from Mega Showdown (hoenmonuments:marinetemple) found in deep oceans
![Marine temple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6057465b0c3e171b368f5250fa6d4108ccac5ebb_0.webp)

Finally Groudon can be spawned by rightclicking on a Terra Pedestal with Mega Showdown's Red Orb item in the Magma Shrine structure which spawns in Nether Wastes biomes (hoenmonuments:magma_shrine)
![magma shrine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/005d0793ce551bd2c6450d4f9e2262f608940d6a_0.webp)

Note: This structure does have some weird spawn quirks like spawning on a floating island or hidden inside netherrack so I might change that in a later update, that being said the structure is completly functional

Currently there is no map or compass to find these structures but I might add this in a later update for now you can try to find them by exploring your world or using the /locate command the namespace of the mods structures is hoenmonuments:

Important stuff:

You can summon one of each legendary per player per world, summoning the legendary removes the pedestal you used for it from the world, meaning that for structures with only one pedestal other players will have to find their own structure to also get the legendary. Right now Sky Pillar is the only structure with 2 pedestals so two players can use one sky pillar structure before a new one has to be found.

This mod also uses the mod Chipped for building blocks used in the new structures: [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped)

If you have any suggestions for more legendary structures let me know in the comments
